text:
**Subject:** Heater out in apartment 4B

Dear Ms. Alvarez,

The heater in apartment 4B stopped working on October 2. I called you on October 3 and have not had a response.

Overnight temperatures are in the 40s °F, and section 12 of my lease requires you to provide heat.

Please send a repair person and have the heater repaired within 48 hours. I have no preference on timing, so please propose a time for the visit.

Thank you,

[Your name]
